subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should Telegram expose a public parse/text mode config, and if so which modes and scopes should be supported?
rationale: This would add public config/API surface in a compatibility-sensitive channel, and the choice between plain, HTML, MarkdownV2, rich messages, and raw/custom-emoji support changes escaping, delivery, and security posture.

options.title: Add a narrow plugin config
options.body: Expose a typed Telegram-owned setting with current HTML as the default plus an explicit plain/no-parse option, and treat MarkdownV2/raw/custom-emoji support as separate decisions or follow-ups.

options.title: Keep existing knobs only
options.body: Continue supporting `richMessages`, `markdown.tables`, and HTML/plain fallbacks without adding another public parse-mode surface.

options.title: Broaden to rich formatting policy
options.body: Design a larger Telegram formatting policy that covers parse mode, rich messages, custom emoji, and raw trusted payloads together before implementation.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow plugin config
recommendation.body: Expose a typed Telegram-owned setting with current HTML as the default plus an explicit plain/no-parse option, and treat MarkdownV2/raw/custom-emoji support as separate decisions or follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the Telegram HTML/default-formatting path and current config-policy surface among the sampled owners.
